summary: Western Alliance Bancorporation filed an 8-K reporting routine quarterly dividends. On July 30, 2026, the Board declared a $0.42 per share common dividend payable August 27, 2026 to holders of record August 13, 2026, and a preferred dividend of $106.25 per share (or $0.265625 per depositary share) payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 15, 2026. No special situation, strategic transaction, or corporate action is involved. The filing merely discloses standard dividend declarations and includes an exhibit index with the cover page interactive data. This is routine operating activity, not a special situation.
